evidence: Redesigns CScriptWitness and transaction deserialization in src/primitives/transaction.h, src/script/script.h, and src/validation.cpp to eliminate validation-time DoS.
rationale: Mitigates a block deserialization denial-of-service vector where adversaries can craft 4 MB blocks that allocate over 110 MB of RAM and consume excessive CPU. Benchmarks show deserialization time dropping from over 300 ms to under 20 ms and memory allocations dropping from over 100 MB to 4.0 MB.
